items.title: Bexicaserin — watch list
items.detail: Selective 5-HT₂C agonist, same mechanism as Fintepla without cardiac 5-HT₂B risk. Phase 3 starting Germany Nov 2025. Not relevant while seizure-free. Mention to neurologist as future option if Fintepla needs replacing. Commercial availability ~2028–2030.
